descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S22 「本地栈上的 iOS 模拟器包，以及时钟错了的真手机」 iOS simulator build on the local stack, and a real phone with a wrong clock

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 4；TFA-92599 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-04） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • G3.8 Every time-based rule uses the server clock: retention, carry-forward, the day roll to Follow-up, 'today' on the timeline and the hospital day / visit number. …（UAT 3.8；TFA-92584 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given iOS: a local simulator build bundled for the local stack. Wrong clock: a real Android phone on the local stack through adb reverse, date set 2 days ahead and time zone Pacific/Kiritimati. A desktop browser on the same account for comparison.

When Switch contexts, background and reopen the app; compare the hospital day / visit number, the badge and its pre-selected template, and the timeline's 'today' with the desktop

Then The context is remembered after reopen; the template lists match the web (S04); no Clinic; the same day/visit, badge, pre-selected template and 'today' as the desktop (3.8)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：S04's checkpoints and S26's equality rule, judged by a person. Device clock: known TFA-92584 AC 8.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
